purpose: Reuse original GSM8K CLI and PPO; add independent per-GPU launchers for cluster and native Windows, early timing, optional-asset resolution, verified snapshots, Windows process/status portability, and multi-seed report wording. Smoke likelihood checks preserve the configured forward batch and padding shapes; PPO update semantics and check tolerances remain unchanged. External helpers now support one shared preparation, three isolated arm-training jobs, verified checkpoint merging, and original single-GPU finalization without further runtime edits. External memory profiles now select 12/24/48 GB execution batches; the 12 GB profile keeps the actor on GPU and parks inactive frozen graders on CPU. The scientific runtime and legacy 24 GB recipe remain byte-identical. Windows workers now retry temporary atomic-replacement access conflicts through an external I/O adapter, with unchanged scientific runtime and legacy checkpoint identity. Windows scripts and package verification support the Windows folder beside recreate3 and use delete-sharing status readers.
